Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “the pro soccer organization headquartered in Atlanta” as the franchise Atlanta United FC (confusing a team with an organization). This misframing led to the incorrect final conclusion in step 8, where the Planner listed both New York City FC and New York Red Bulls; only New York City FC is actually based in New York City (the city tied to the No Wave album “No New York”), while the Red Bulls are based in Harrison, New Jersey.
